query:
SELECT
                COUNT(pk_systems.uuid) AS "count!"
            FROM
                pk_systems
            LEFT JOIN
                pk_system_fronters
            ON pk_systems.uuid = pk_system_fronters.system_uuid
            WHERE (
                    pk_system_fronters.updated_at IS NULL
                OR
                    EXTRACT(epoch FROM pk_system_fronters.updated_at)::bigint <= $1
            ) AND (
                    uuid IN (
                        SELECT
                            system_uuid
                        FROM
                            pk_notify_systems
                        INNER JOIN
                            guilds
                        ON
                            guilds.guild_id = pk_notify_systems.guild_id
                        WHERE
                            guilds.deleted_at IS NULL
                    )
                OR
                    uuid IN (
                        SELECT
                            system_uuid
                        FROM
                            pk_guilds
                        INNER JOIN
                            pk_fronters
                        ON
                            pk_guilds.guild_id = pk_fronters.guild_id
                        INNER JOIN
                            guilds
                        ON
                            pk_guilds.guild_id = guilds.guild_id
                        WHERE
                            guilds.deleted_at IS NULL
                    )
            )
